Dear Willa Thomas,

Receiving your dispute letter regarding the account referenced above, we acknowledge your assertion that the account has already been paid. We take all disputes seriously and will investigate this matter further.

Pursuant to the Fair Debt Collection Practices Act (FDCPA), we are required to validate the debt upon your request. We confirm that you have requested validation of the account, and we will provide you with the necessary documentation to support the debt.

We have reviewed the account information, and the current balance is $5,906.53. The original creditor for this account is Valley Regional Hospital. The charge-off date was July 8, 2021, and the last payment was received on April 18, 2022.

We will investigate the claim that the account has already been paid and will provide you with an update on our findings. If our investigation confirms that the account has been paid in full, we will take the necessary steps to remove the account from our records and update our reporting to the credit bureaus.

Please note that you have the right to further dispute this account if you believe the debt is not valid. If you wish to continue disputing the account, please provide us with additional information or documentation to support your claim.

Sincerely,

Continental Receivables Corp.
